body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0189 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "CMSTP / InstallUtil / Regasm LOLBin execution - Behavior: CMSTP / InstallUtil / Regasm LOLBin execution. Anchor after classic/XML coalesce. Not telemetry_validated."
    severity = "Medium"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0189"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1218.003"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1218.004"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    ($e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\cmstp\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\installutil\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\regasm\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\regsvcs\.exe$/ nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
